summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ALPS Active Equity Opportunity ETF (RFFC) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Composite 1500 index. The fund is an actively managed fund that broadly invests in stocks of various market capitalization. At least 75% of assets are invested in securities by US issuers. RFFC was launched on Jun 7, 2016 and is issued by SS&C.

holdings.infoBox: RFFC is an equity ETF with a total of 60 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 5.83%, NVIDIA at 5.50%, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 5.45%, Apple at 5.38%, and Alphabet at 4.69%.
